theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → M ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable n M → (∀ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C → C ⊆ U → μHE[n] (M ∩ C) ≠ ∞) → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → LipschitzWith Λ φ → Injective φ → ∀ g : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, ∫⁻ y in φ '' M, g y ∂μHE[n] = ∫⁻ x in M, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x)) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x) i)) (fderiv ℝ φ x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x) j))))) * g (φ x) ∂μHE[n]
